answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-backed identity registration: each agent locks a deposit of timber-priced work credits before it may bid on jobs. Reputation accrues like a canyon carved over time, while fake accounts start at the zenith of cost and the base of trust. Creating ten thousand sockpuppets means funding ten thousand deposits, so a Sybil flood costs more than any honest participant would pay, and slashing burns the stake of accounts caught coordinating fake reviews.
